boundaries.name: Operational tool execution (SOC mitigations)
boundaries.gated_by: CTRL-L3-02 (PEP capability gateway), CTRL-L3-01 (allow-list), CTRL-L6-03 (signed policy-bundle allow-list, two-person change), CTRL-L5-08 (environmental verifier veto), CTRL-L5-06 (HMDC gated critique), CTRL-L3-04 (executor sandbox: scope + output confinement), CTRL-L4-05 (durable exactly-once replay)
boundaries.notes: THE consequential boundary. In this offline reproduction the adapters model the effect (throttle/thresholds/capture/alert/rollback). The intent must be permitted by the active signed policy bundle (CTRL-L6-03) — a versioned, two-person-approved allow-list whose integrity is re-verified here. Before the side effect a pre-execution critique gate (BP7) runs the HMDC engine + the deterministic environmental verifier, vetoing a mitigation inappropriate/unsafe for the observed alert; the adapter then runs inside an in-process ExecutionSandbox that confines the result to the authorized scope and replays it exactly-once across a crash. In production the adapters would call a firewall/SOAR/capture control through an OS-level sandbox (gVisor/Firecracker) backed by Temporal.io. No model output reaches here except through a typed, authorized, allow-listed, environmentally-verified proposal.

boundaries.name: Tamper-evident audit ledger append
boundaries.gated_by: CTRL-L5-02 (ledger is the record, not a gated action)
boundaries.notes: Append-only, HMAC-signed, hash-chained; optionally persisted to disk. Deletion/modification is detectable via verify_chain().

boundaries.name: Persistent memory write / promotion
boundaries.reversible: yes (records are versioned; promotion is audited)
boundaries.notes: External content lands UNTRUSTED (quarantine-on-ingest). Promotion to TRUSTED and cross-tenant reads have no autonomous path — each needs an independent scoped capability and is recorded in the ledger.

boundaries.name: Capability token issuance / delegation
boundaries.reversible: n/a (tokens are short-lived; scope only narrows)
boundaries.notes: HMAC-signed, scoped, TTL-bounded authority. Delegation cannot widen scope or outlive its parent (MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH).

boundaries.name: Outbound model/provider HTTP call
boundaries.notes: The ONLY egress off the box. OFF the default offline loop, which uses the deterministic stub reasoner. Keys from env, never persisted; fallback fails closed rather than downgrading tier.

boundaries.name: Host packet replay (experiment TC1)
boundaries.reversible: no (emits real packets on an interface)
boundaries.gated_by: experiment-only; NOT on the agent control plane
boundaries.notes: Best-effort side effect of the DoS reproduction; the reported metric is the MODELED saturation curve (A13), not this send. Never reachable from an agent action.

boundaries.name: Filesystem result/log writes
boundaries.gated_by: n/a (developer tooling, not an agent capability)
boundaries.notes: Writes to results/ and docs/audit/. Not reachable from a model proposal; produced by explicit developer/CI invocation.

boundaries.name: Legacy memory file write (pre-enforcement path)
boundaries.notes: The paper's poisonable history.json. Retained for the TC2 reproduction; the enforced path is memory/store.py (SEB-03).
